# Footer block

> Site footers.

Install doc for the **Footer block** of ui-kit: 2 variants built only from ui-kit components. React >=18.2 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add the Footer block to this project exactly as specified here. If the user did not say which variant, ask, or install the first one.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Install these components first**, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Follow each one's doc, or run the download script below, which covers all of them:
   - `badge`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/badge.md
   - `button`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/button.md
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
   - `input`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/input.md
3. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/badge.css";
   @import "./components/button.css";
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/input.css";
   ```

4. **Create the block.** Save the variant verbatim as its own file, for example `components/blocks/footer/<variant>.tsx` inside the `@/` folder, then render it from a page. Change the copy (names, prices, links) only if the user asks.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Block: Footer

The last section of a marketing site: brand, navigation to everything else, legal links and copyright. A marketing block: kit components (`Badge`, `Button`, `Input`, `Label`) plus Tailwind utilities.

#### Variants
```
multi-column   brand + blurb + newsletter form | <nav> with 4 link columns · bottom bar: ©, live status badge, social links
minimal        one row: logo + © | <nav> with 6 links; wraps on phones; zero JS (Server Component)
```

#### Anatomy (multi-column)
```
<footer>                           rounded-2xl border bg-background, px 20 → 32px, pt 56 → 64px, pb 32px
  <div ref> .ui-stagger            revealed on scroll
    grid lg:[1.1fr 2fr]
      brand column                 logo link · blurb · <form>
        <form onSubmit>            <Label htmlFor> · <Input type="email" required name="email"> + <Button type="submit">
          <p role="status">        hint, replaced by "Thanks! The next issue goes to …" after submit
      <nav aria-label="Footer">    grid 2 cols → 4 from sm; each column: <h2> 13px/500 + <ul> of 13px muted links, 12px apart
    bottom bar                     border-t, pt 24px: © 2026 · <a><Badge variant="success" size="sm" live>All systems normal</Badge></a> · social links
```

#### Visual rules
- Links `text-sm text-muted-foreground`, `hover:text-foreground` (150ms colour transition only).
- Newsletter: input and button side by side from `sm`, stacked on phones; form `max-w-sm`.
- The rounded border is the docs frame; drop `rounded-2xl border` for a full-bleed footer (use `border-t`).
- Left-aligned text throughout.

#### Motion
- Multi-column: one `.ui-stagger` group (the main grid, then the bottom bar), added when 10% in view; `motion-safe:opacity-0` before that.
- The status badge dot pulses (`live`); reduced motion stops the pulse.
- Minimal: no entrance; it is the last thing on the page.

#### Accessibility
- `<footer>` is the page's contentinfo landmark when it is a direct child of `<body>`.
- Link columns live in one `<nav aria-label="Footer">`; column titles are headings so screen-reader users can jump between them.
- The email field has a visible label, `type="email"`, `autocomplete="email"` and `required`; the result is announced through `role="status"`.

#### Responsive
- 360px: brand block, then a 2-column link grid, then the bottom bar stacked.
- `sm`: 4 link columns. `lg`: brand column beside the links. Minimal: one row from `md`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Submitting a valid email shows the thank-you line without reloading the page.
- No horizontal overflow at 360px; axe reports no serious violations.

Imports are rewritten from the package to the local files (`@/ui/...`).

### Multi-column with newsletter

File: `components/blocks/footer/multi-column.tsx` (docs source: `apps/docs/examples/blocks/footer/multi-column.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Input } from '@/ui/components/input';

const COLUMNS = [
  { title: 'Product', links: ['Rollouts', 'Feature flags', 'Incidents', 'On-call', 'Status pages', 'Changelog'] },
  { title: 'Resources', links: ['Documentation', 'API reference', 'Guides', 'Release academy', 'Community'] },
  { title: 'Company', links: ['About', 'Customers', 'Careers', 'Press', 'Contact'] },
  { title: 'Legal', links: ['Privacy', 'Terms', 'Security', 'DPA', 'Cookie settings'] },
];

const SOCIAL = ['GitHub', 'LinkedIn', 'YouTube'];

function Logo() {
  return (
    <span className="grid size-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="size-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.25} strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden="true">
        <path d="M4 15c2.5-4 5.5-4 8 0s5.5 4 8 0" />
        <path d="M4 9c2.5-4 5.5-4 8 0s5.5 4 8 0" opacity={0.55} />
      </svg>
    </span>
  );
}

function useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setShown(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
          setShown(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, shown] as const;
}

export default function FooterMultiColumn() {
  const [ref, shown] = useReveal<HTMLDivElement>();
  const emailId = useId();
  const [subscribed, setSubscribed] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const onSubmit = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const email = new FormData(e.currentTarget).get('email');
    // Send it to your mailing list provider here
    setSubscribed(typeof email === 'string' ? email : '');
  };

  return (
    <footer className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-5 pt-14 pb-8 sm:px-8 sm:pt-16">
      <div ref={ref} className={`mx-auto max-w-6xl ${shown ? 'ui-stagger' : 'motion-safe:opacity-0'}`}>
        <div className="grid gap-12 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.1fr)_minmax(0,2fr)] lg:gap-16">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <a href="#" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md font-display text-md font-semibold tracking-tight">
              <Logo />
              Halcyon
            </a>
            <p className="mt-4 max-w-sm text-md text-muted-foreground">
              Release management and incident response for teams that ship every day.
            </p>

            <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="mt-8 max-w-sm">
              <Label htmlFor={emailId}>The release notes, monthly</Label>
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
                <Input
                  id={emailId}
                  name="email"
                  type="email"
                  required
                  autoComplete="email"
                  placeholder="you@company.com"
                  className="min-w-0 flex-1"
                />
                <Button type="submit">Subscribe</Button>
              </div>
              <p role="status" className="mt-2 min-h-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {subscribed !== null ? `Thanks! The next issue goes to ${subscribed || 'your inbox'}.` : 'One email a month. Unsubscribe any time.'}
              </p>
            </form>
          </div>

          <nav aria-label="Footer" className="grid min-w-0 grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-10 sm:grid-cols-4">
            {COLUMNS.map((col) => (
              <div key={col.title} className="min-w-0">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-medium">{col.title}</h2>
                <ul className="mt-4 grid gap-3">
                  {col.links.map((link) => (
                    <li key={link}>
                      <a href="#" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-150 hover:text-foreground">
                        {link}
                      </a>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            ))}
          </nav>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-14 flex flex-col gap-4 border-t border-border pt-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
            <p>© 2026 Halcyon Labs, Inc.</p>
            <a href="#" className="rounded-full">
              <Badge variant="success" size="sm" live>
                All systems normal
              </Badge>
            </a>
          </div>
          <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-2">
            {SOCIAL.map((s) => (
              <li key={s}>
                <a href="#" className="transition-colors duration-150 hover:text-foreground">
                  {s}
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>
  );
}
```
